body:
PM handoff — PR #12 accepted; final localized causal event aggregation authorized

EARWORM_MERGED_SHA=33e9bc816b825a7f8e610be9e7cd8d5f0fb06603
EARWORM_NEXT_INSTRUCTION_SHA=33e9bc816b825a7f8e610be9e7cd8d5f0fb06603
EARWORM_ASSIGNMENT_ID=earworm-causal-event-aggregation-v1
Instruction version: 1

Source PR: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/12
Reviewed publication: `33e9bc816b825a7f8e610be9e7cd8d5f0fb06603`
Confirmed merge / exact next base: `704d59d604d34a51c3c0f64ebc971b0346ce0aef`
Review: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/12#pullrequestreview-5262034308
Held-out execution: `5bb5cd23d2ed55144dde7a84dc5f4bbd4500ff00`

Selected branch B. Accept the snapshot and its causal evidence, but do not adopt trim16 or advance musical complexity. On fresh held-out groups it improved pitch accuracy .727647→.969580, eliminated observed octave errors, and improved joint reference prediction 14/48→45/48. It still failed familywise noninferiority, joint Brier tolerance, four ambiguity groups and the fundamental-rendering safety family. Oracle boundaries passed all relevant controls. This pattern makes one final localized event-measurement comparison decision-relevant: whether uncertainty-preserving aggregation of multiple arrived within-event observations fixes missing/overconfident measurements, or whether crop/aggregation micro-repairs should end in favor of a different event representation. This is not another descriptive audit.

Authorization: one implement-AND-run assignment under Brian's continuous 24/7 in-plan delegation. Reconcile receipt 5753312965, live main/open PRs, processed comment/version/assignment/SHA tracking and the no-overlap lock. No active successor existed at handoff. Reuse matching work if it now exists; never restart or dispatch a duplicate.

Which finish-line capability does this assignment establish or unblock? Reliable causal event-derived measurements with calibrated uncertainty from continuous audio, required before session memory can recognize transformed material or improve forecasts without supplied boundaries.

Decision: should an uncertainty-preserving causal aggregation of within-event acoustic observations become the accepted streaming measurement front?
Result A → if every validity, prediction, calibration, event, control and safety gate passes, retain the aggregator as the versioned streaming front; after review advance to one decision-qualified isolated-voice recognition/transformation milestone.
Result B → if event/pitch/safety gates pass but forecast proper-score or ambiguity gates fail while oracle passes, retain the aggregator only as a measurement candidate, withhold the streaming capability claim, and make the next roadmap decision specifically about a bounded uncertainty/readout repair—not another boundary experiment.
Result C → if pitch/event/family gates still fail or the aggregator regresses trim16, reject it, preserve trim16 only as non-adopted evidence, and end crop/within-event aggregation micro-repairs. After review choose a different event representation or checkpoint a concrete blocker under the decision filter.
Invalid/inconclusive → preserve all outcomes and stop; no post-hoc rerun, threshold weakening, or forced architectural selection.
Stop condition: finite development, one frozen held-out evaluation, one complete reproducible successor, then awaiting-review and stop. No worker self-dispatch.

IMPLEMENT AND RUN ONE FINAL LOCALIZED MEASUREMENT TEST

Create `experiments/causal-event-aggregation-v1/` from exact main `704d59d604d34a51c3c0f64ebc971b0346ce0aef`. Preserve E08 and PRs #8–#12 byte-for-byte. Freeze PR #11 b2 event boundaries, 64ms chunks, 32ms windows / 4ms hops, confirmation/state rules, PR #10 NSDF adapter/config, PR #8 retrieval/config and probability bins. Preserve PR #12 trim16 unchanged as a comparator. Do not add a new encoder, supplied boundaries, expected-pitch snapping, generator metadata, relational objective or predictor training.

At event completion, form one versioned causal measurement from multiple already-arrived acoustic observations whose analysis windows lie inside the inferred event. Preserve every per-window pitch candidate, periodicity, RMS, window/sample bounds, source hash, computation/availability time and original whole-event/trim16 observations. Aggregate candidates without silently overwriting captured evidence. Report a pitch probability/uncertainty distribution plus a separately labeled point interpretation for the unchanged simple retrieval comparator.

Before development, define a finite set of at most four aggregation policies using only arrived evidence—for example fixed robust consensus variants over eligible 32/48/64ms subwindows with deterministic periodicity weighting and explicit unknown mass. Keep rules simple and fully specified: eligibility, octave-family handling, outlier rejection, minimum evidence, distribution construction and tie-breaks. Development selects exactly one by a frozen lexicographic objective: validity/availability, pitch accuracy, intact forecast proper score, then simplest/least-state policy. Calibration may fit at most one preregistered scalar uncertainty temperature or unknown-mass parameter using calibration groups only; it may not select event boundaries, rewrite measurements, or alter retrieval matching. If no feasible development policy exists, checkpoint and stop before evaluation.

Use the selected measurement distribution in two declared paths:
1. unchanged MAP-point simple retrieval, testing measurement quality without readout changes;
2. one lightweight uncertainty-aware retrieval mixture that marginalizes the frozen PR #8 lookup over the event's candidate distribution and retains unknown mass.
No learned controller. Give present-only, recency, transitions1–3, absolute and transformation-aware retrieval the same observations/history/capacity within each path. Trim16, whole-span, fixed-window and evaluator-only oracle remain explicit comparators; oracle never enters the worker.

FRESH CONTROLLED DESIGN

Use 40 new disjoint motif groups: 8 development, 8 calibration, 24 evaluation; all variants of a group stay in one split and normalized motif/continuation families have zero overlap with all earlier studies. Preserve the four PR #11/#12 cells—detached, legato, unseen duration jitter, and joint legato/duration/timbre—and their declared aliases/limitations. New seeds and pitched-wave hashes; same byte-identical paired current probes, balanced source-sound inventories/counts/frequency/duration/timbre/energy, balanced order/recency, equal accessible memory and zero eviction.

Retain reset, relevant-memory removal, swap, information-preserving whole-motif shuffle and ambiguous-history controls in joint with valid labels. Add no new scientific condition. The worker receives contiguous arrived PCM chunks/order only. Forecast logs are append-only and fsynced before continuation bytes arrive or are extracted. Verify withheld-future invariance, process isolation, causal timestamps, storage accounting and fixed non-overlapping target windows.

PREREGISTRATION

Before generating/exposing held-out waveforms, post one PR #2 receipt with exact base; protocol/code/config/split/model hashes; candidate policies and selected policy; calibration parameter/range and fit rule; probability coordinates; latency; memory/resource ledger; event matching; metrics; bootstrap seed/quantiles; controls; branch criteria and frozen execution commit. Development chooses policy, calibration fits only the declared uncertainty scalar, and held-out runs once. No group replacement, evaluation tuning, acoustic rerun, repaired retest or weakened gate.

Analyze equally by phrase group with 5,000 paired group bootstrap samples and familywise intervals across four selected-minus-oracle cells. Report every model/path/front/cell/control: accuracy, both-members success, log loss, Brier, entropy/unknown mass and calibration; event F1/split/merge, pitch availability/error/octaves; candidate count/concentration/disagreement; latency, measured processing time and storage. Report MAP-only and uncertainty-aware paths separately so calibration cannot conceal measurement errors.

ADOPTION AND BRANCH GATES

Validity first: fresh separated groups; preregistration; exact paired bytes/current probe; causal API/process guard and pre-reveal durability; future invariance; equal accessible memory; exact historical hashes; correct controls; all resource limits; independent saved-result reconstruction.

Oracle reference paired success >=.80 in every cell or select C.
For A, the selected uncertainty-aware reference must meet ALL:
- paired success >=.80 in every cell;
- selected-minus-oracle accuracy familywise lower95 >=-.10 in every cell;
- joint advantage over present-only and PR #12 trim16 each has positive paired lower95;
- joint log-loss increase versus oracle <=.10 and Brier increase <=.02;
- group-weighted event F1 >=.90, pitched-event accuracy within .35 semitone >=.95 with unavailable/missing counted as failures, split/merge each <=.05, octave errors <=.01;
- actual arrived-audio latency <=160ms, with computation/dispatch timing reported separately and no feature backdating;
- reset/removal paired success <=.10, accuracy <=.55 and paired TV <=1e-9; swap counterpart error <=1e-9 and paired success >=.80; shuffle accuracy drop <=.10; ambiguous intended-alternative mass >=.90, each within .10 of .5 and max class probability <=.60;
- no preregistered rendering family loses >.10 group-mean accuracy versus oracle;
- immutable raw evidence, per-window candidates, trim16/original observations and realization details remain separately recoverable.

Select B only when measurement/event/safety gates pass but prediction calibration/ambiguity gates fail and oracle passes. Select C when measurement/event/family gates fail, trim16 is not materially improved, or the new approach regresses. Nonsignificance is not equivalence/noninferiority. Preserve baseline wins and all failed outcomes.

RESOURCES AND PUBLICATION

Caps: <=1,000 total episode/control/invariance streams, <=2 hours aggregate local compute, <=2GiB new artifacts, <=32 arrived chunks per forecast and <=2-second completed waveform units. Reserve held-out budget first; count every acoustic execution/probe and all candidate-policy computations; do not split work to evade caps. Count all predictor-accessible raw buffers, per-window candidates, recurrent state, events, fronts and caches; evaluator archive inaccessible. This short-history task makes no eviction or long-term-retention claim.

No spending, paid compute/fallback, limit increases, purchased/reset credits, foundation training, MERT changes/downloads, deployment, force-push or signal-only commits. If required evidence/resources are unavailable, preserve a recoverable checkpoint with the concrete blocker and known reset information; no busy retries or historical regeneration.

Publish ONE complete successor targeting main with isolated code, frozen protocol/config, recipes/hashes, evidence caches, per-window/support provenance, pre-reveal logs, calibrated outputs, independent validation, all group/model/control results, concise report, execution/publication provenance, checksums, checkpoint and ordinary `PROJECT_STATE.md` update. Preserve the top transformed-recognition goal, finite capability checklist and broad-domain finish line; update only demonstrated status. No documentation-only PR.

New PR: draft → `earworm-review-ready` → ready. Update a matching active ready PR only with the complete labeled snapshot. Link exact publication/execution SHAs, outputs and PR here. Save awaiting-review, release lock and stop. Preserve the existing 30-minute poll; no duplicate worker/reviewer, wake-up or schedule change.
